Language martyr Barkat's family complains about grabbing effort
2014-02-19T00:00:39+06:00 | Our Correspondent, Gazipur
https://www.thedailystar.net/language-martyr-barkats-family-complains-about-grabbing-effort-12027

The family of Shaheed Barkat, a Language Movement martyr, submitted a written complaint to the deputy commissioner of Gazipur yesterday alleging that a ward councillor of the city has been harassing them over their land given to them by the government. Shaheed Barkat's nephew Ain Uddin Barkat said Md Safar Ali, councillor of ward-18, filed a case with the land office concerned saying they were not the real owners of the land. In 1981, the then government allocated 0.68 acres of land in Kacharibari under Naljani Mauja in Gazipur to Hazi Hasina Bibi, mother of Shaheed Barkat, said Ain Uddin. On April 21, 1982, Hasina Bibi died and according to the government decision she was buried in the land, he said, adding that thenceforth her heirs had been possessing the land. They built some tin-shed shops on some portion of the land to earn a living, he said. Ain Uddin said recently they had applied for Review Survey (RS) mutation to the office of the assistant commissioner (land). But the ward councillor Safar Ali applied to the deputy commissioner and assistant commissioner (land) requesting not to provide the mutation and filed the case alleging that they were not the heirs of Hasina Bibi, he said. Ain Uddin said the councillor also demanded extortion money from them, an allegation Safar Ali denied.
